name: cache-timer
description: Shows how long the main conversation's prompt cache stays warm (1h / 5m) next to the model and permission labels, with an optional progress bar; 中文 / English

language.title: Language / 语言
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting (English if unset); zh = 中文, en = English. Affects the expiry reminders.

showBar.title: Show progress bar / 显示进度条
showBar.description: Show the bar before the countdown; off shows only the time
